title: Banking Ombudsman
definition: The Banking Ombudsman Scheme is a quasi-judicial apex grievance redressal mechanism established under Section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, enabling bank customers to resolve complaints relating to deficiency in banking services.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding jurisdiction, appeal mechanism, and institutional integration under the Reserve Bank-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS). Crucial for Mains GS Paper III (Inclusive Growth, Financial Inclusion, and Consumer Protection).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of the Banking Ombudsman.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of RBI functions and Commercial Banking
